_comment: Who is speaking to whom, where it is not simply the verse's recorded speaker. Chapter 1's opening is Sanjaya REPORTING Duryodhana's words to Drona, so the recorded speaker (Sanjaya) is the narrator rather than the voice in the scene — which is exactly the confusion a first-time reader hits.
1.11: Duryodhana → his army, reported by Sanjaya
11.32: Krishna → Arjuna, in the universal form
